title: Footsteps become a signal
alt: A trail of large bootprints crosses the lunar soil toward a seismic package. The right half of the artwork cuts to a paper recorder with a stylized waveform.
context: The instrument detected nearby crew activity, which gave engineers and scientists context for interpreting its output. The displayed waveform is illustrative, not a flight recording.
interpretation: Original story illustration. Viewpoint, lighting, pose, geometry and apparent distances are interpretive. Scientific arrows, waves, cutaways and displays explain principles; they are not recorded telemetry, a literal instrument diagram or a historical photograph.

sources.label: NASA · The seismometer detects the crew’s footsteps
